# Self-hosted VPS (Docker Compose, PM2, Nginx or CloudPanel)

These rules add to the core build skills of the quality pack.

## Rules

- Docker Compose: restart: unless-stopped, memory limits, database and Redis with no published ports (internal network only).
- PM2: versioned ecosystem file, pm2 startup then pm2 save, log rotation with pm2-logrotate.
- Nginx or CloudPanel: forced HTTPS, HTTP/2, gzip or brotli, long caching on versioned static files.
- Server: SSH keys only, ufw with 22, 80 and 443, fail2ban, unattended-upgrades.
- Daily pg_dump and user-file backup, encrypted (restic or borg), sent off the VPS; alert on failure.
- Restore tested every quarter on a separate environment, with date and duration recorded in docs/ops.
- Deploy through a versioned script (git pull, install, migrate, build, reload) and a Git tag per release, to roll back in one command.

## Check commands

Used by `/qp:audit`. `{pm}` is the project's package manager, `{url}` the app URL, `{host}` its host name.

| Check | Command | Passes if |
| --- | --- | --- |
| port_scan | `nmap -Pn --top-ports 1000 {host}` | only 22, 80 and 443 open (or the documented list) |
| headers_check | `curl -sI https://{host}` | HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy present; content-encoding on assets |
